C1048.title: Apple Faces Lawsuit Over BYOD Practices
C1048.summary: TechTarget reports that Apple is facing a lawsuit over its BYOD policy, accused of turning employee personal devices into privacy-invading 'prisons' and blurring the line between work and personal life. The litigation highlights potential privacy violations and legal compliance issues arising from BYOD policies.

references.title: Apple's BYOD practices draw fire in lawsuit - TechTarget
